Well, it failed my basic test. I asked it:
"Do you know the difference between the app router and pages router in next.js 14?"

It answered:
"-The app router is the default router in Next.js. It is used to navigate between pages in your Next.js app.
-The pages router is a new router introduced in Next.js 14. It is designed to provide a more flexible and customizable routing solution."

The second bullet is completely wrong. In other words, it cannot write modern next js code, but in fairness, neither can chatGPT.

comments.author: @avi7278
comments.text: The biggest problem is the context window with these open source models. The 128,000 context window of gpt 4 turbo is the must for me. Plus the open source models just aren't good enough yet for real serious coding at a real world production level. Sendex is a bit of a python script kiddy, excuse the terminology, but it's true, and the open source models might work to whip together a little python script, but when it comes to following 5, 6, 7 layers of instruction over 10 separate files as context and correctly determining diffs making those edit cleanly, these models like llama are just simply not enough. The only model that even comes close to being able to do what I needed it to do at a level that is relatively satisfactory is GPT4.
